last.q: Q1 was a strong start to fiscal 2027, with RPO up 44% and Teamwork Collection customers up 7x year-over-year,
last.a: said Mike Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and Co‑Founder

last.q: Q4 closes out a year that proves our long-term strategy is paying off. Total revenue grew 28% year-over-year to $1.8 billion, Cloud revenue growth accelerated to 31% year-over-year, and our MCP server and Teamwork Graph CLI surpassed one million monthly active users, more than doubling in a single quarter,
last.a: said Mike Cannon‑Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and co‑Founder

last.q: Our strong Q3 results show the power of our strategy in action, with total revenue growing 32% year-over-year to $1.8 billion, as customers sign bigger, longer-term commitments, and connect their teams and workflows on our AI-powered platform,
last.a: said Mike Cannon‑Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and co‑Founder

last.q: We closed out Q2 with incredible momentum across the Atlassian platform and achieved some impressive milestones along the way. We delivered our first-ever $1 billion Cloud revenue quarter, which grew 26% year-over-year, crossed 350,000 customers, and Rovo surpassed 5 million monthly active users,
last.a: said Mike Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and co-Founder

last.q: Our relentless pace of AI innovation is driving results as we grew Cloud revenue in Q1 to $998 million, up 26% year-over-year, and surpassed 3.5 million monthly active users of our AI capabilities, up 50% quarter-over-quarter,
last.a: said Mike Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and co-Founder

last.q: Using AI is easy, creating value is harder. Today's announcement is about helping our 300,000+ customers understand if they’re making the right investments to win in the AI era,
last.a: said Mike Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and co-Founder
